title: Clear claims
note: PILOT 2026-08-05 · claim logic for writing (overgeneral, stance, weak claim, language). Spot-the-problem quiz. Not formal philosophy. See docs/LOGIC_CLAIMS_PILOT.md. · RUE2 TRANSPLANT 2026-08-25: blocks+intro restored from rue2-grok-v1.0 (James-smoked, quality=pilot); auto-authored bank superseded.

items.en: Personally speaking, technology gives negative impact on families.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: Personally speaking, technology gives negative impact on families. → ____
items.explanation: Main language fault: gives impact → has a negative impact/effect. (Also stance + overgeneral — intro covers layers; primary label here = language.)
items.explanation_cz: Hlavně jazyk: gives impact → has a negative impact. (I postoj a zobecnění — v intro.)

items.en: Personally speaking, all teenagers hate reading.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: Personally speaking, all teenagers hate reading. → ____
items.explanation: Personally speaking does not fit a universal claim about all teenagers. (Also overgeneral — primary here = stance.)
items.explanation_cz: Personally speaking se nehodí k obecnému tvrzení o všech teenagech.

items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.explanation: Every family is too absolute. Hedge: can harm / some families / often…
items.explanation_cz: Every family je příliš absolutní. Zjemni: can harm / some families…

items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.explanation: Big judgment with no reason or limit. A clearer claim needs why, for whom, or in what way.
items.explanation_cz: Velký soud bez důvodu. Doplň proč / pro koho / jak.

items.en: In my experience, group chats help my family plan weekends.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: In my experience, group chats help my family plan weekends. → ____
items.explanation: Stance fits (in my experience), scope is limited (my family, weekends), English is fine.
items.explanation_cz: Postoj sedí, rozsah je omezený, angličtina je v pořádku.

items.en: Research shows that many parents report less face-to-face talk when phones are at the table.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: Research shows that many parents report less face-to-face talk when phones are at the table. → ____
items.explanation: Limited scope (many parents, when phones at table) and a support signal (research shows). OK for this pilot.
items.explanation_cz: Omezený rozsah a opora (research shows). Pro pilot OK.

items.en: To sum up, phones destroy love.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: To sum up, phones destroy love. → ____
items.explanation: Destroy love is absolute and vague. To sum up needs a fair conclusion, not a slogan.
items.explanation_cz: Destroy love je absolutní a vágní. Závěr má být férový, ne slogan.

items.en: From my point of view, the government should ban all social media tomorrow.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: From my point of view, the government should ban all social media tomorrow. → ____
items.explanation: All + tomorrow is extreme policy with no conditions. Opinion marker is OK; the claim is too absolute.
items.explanation_cz: All + tomorrow je extrém bez podmínek. Postoj OK; tvrzení příliš absolutní.

items.en: Honestly, online games make children more creative when they build and play together.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: Honestly, online games make children more creative when they build and play together. → ____
items.explanation: Limited condition (when they build and play together). Soft stance (honestly) is acceptable for a reasoned opinion.
items.explanation_cz: Omezená podmínka (when…). Mírný postoj je v pořádku.

items.en: It is clear that nobody needs books anymore.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: It is clear that nobody needs books anymore. → ____
items.explanation: Nobody / anymore is absolute. It is clear pretends certainty without support.
items.explanation_cz: Nobody / anymore je absolutní. It is clear předstírá jistotu bez opory.

items.en: Many families argue more when they check phones during meals.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: Many families argue more when they check phones during meals. → ____
items.explanation: Many + when… limits the claim. Clear and usable in an essay (still needs support if you develop it).
items.explanation_cz: Many + when… omezuje tvrzení. Použitelné v eseji.

items.en: In conclusion, because phones exist, society has failed.
items.cz: What is the main problem with this claim?
items.gap: In conclusion, because phones exist, society has failed. → ____
items.explanation: The conclusion does not follow: existence of phones does not prove society has failed. Bad premise → conclusion link.
items.explanation_cz: Závěr neplyne: existence telefonů nedokazuje selhání společnosti.

cards.title: What is a claim?
cards.body: A claim is something you ask the reader to accept. In essays, claims need a fair scope and a reason — not only strong feelings.
points: Claim = idea you want others to take seriously
Good claims are limited enough to discuss
Bad claims are absolute, empty, or do not follow from the reason

cards.title: Premise → conclusion
cards.body: In plain English: **because of this** (premise), **I say that** (conclusion). The conclusion must follow.
points: Premise = reason or support
Conclusion = what you want people to accept
If the conclusion is much bigger than the premise → weak claim

rows: Phones at meals → some families talk less

cards.title: Overgeneralisation
points: Watch **all / every / nobody / always / never / technology / families** used as totals
Hedge: many, some, often, can, tend to, in some homes…
Add a limit: when / for teenagers / in my class…

rows: Phones can reduce talk at some meals.

cards.title: Stance fit
cards.body: Markers like **Personally speaking** / **In my experience** must match the size of the claim.
points: Personal marker + universal claim = stance mismatch
Personal marker + personal evidence = OK
Formal claim → use research / many people / it seems… — not fake personal padding

rows: Personally speaking, all teens hate books.
In my class, some teens avoid long novels.

cards.title: Language vs thinking
cards.body: Sometimes the English is wrong; sometimes the thinking is weak; sometimes **both**.
points: **Language only** — collocation/grammar; idea is fair
**Logic labels** — overgeneral / stance / weak claim
Your example: *gives negative impact* (language) + personal + total claim (thinking)

cards.title: Labels in practice
points: **OK · clear claim** — fair scope; stance fits; English OK enough
**language only** — fix words/grammar first
**overgeneral** — too absolute
**stance mismatch** — marker doesn’t fit the claim
**weak claim** — big conclusion, no real support / does not follow
